name: bcsk
description: BCSK monorepo — an independently deployable NestJS API and a Next.js web app. This manifest exists so tools that expect a root package.json (this workspace's preview launcher, some IDEs) can find one, and to offer convenience scripts that proxy into backend/ and frontend/. `concurrently` runs both dev servers from one `npm run dev`; `cross-env` pins the backend's PORT for that combined run, since a dev-server launcher that injects one PORT for the whole process tree would otherwise point both servers at the same port (backend reads PORT from the environment ahead of .env on purpose — see backend/src/main.ts). Each project still installs, builds, and ships independently — see CLAUDE.md.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=4000 npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
